zoneNotes: Starke Ayres' commercial guideline (titled 'Marrow and Scallop Production Guideline') describes 'the dark green, cylindrical type' marrow as 'the commonest [type] in South Africa' and gives a commercial in-row/row spacing of 40cm x 1.5m for a target population of about 16,000 plants/ha — slightly wider row spacing than KZN DARD's Table 5 range (80-120cm) but the same order of magnitude.
gaps: Winter/Western Cape sowMonths not sourced, for the same reason as gem-squash: KZN DARD's sowing calendar has no Western Cape column, and no Western Cape-specific cucurbit sowing source was found this session.

Individual variety maturity/zone data for Starke Ayres' zucchini/marrow cultivars (Everglade, Monitor, Mira, and others named on the same page: STAR 8024, STAR 8023, Green Tiger) could not be retrieved — only the cultivar names themselves were confirmed from a product-range listing page.
summary: Frost tenderness, transplant status, days-to-harvest (using the 'Marrow, baby' row, a direct match), row/in-row spacing, seed rate and yield are all sourced (KZN DARD Tables 4/5/8, corroborated by Starke Ayres' Marrow and Scallop Production Guideline). Verdict held to 'partial' solely because winter/Western Cape sowMonths could not be sourced.
